major_finding_closure.evidence: Independent fixtures reject a mixed Tier-2 selection and accept only empty or one complete registered same-q branch.
Missing or unqualified reference manifests cannot become reused_valid terminal evidence.
Independent mutations of run ID, seed, qMain and endpoint uniqueness/coverage are rejected before denominator construction.
Duplicate vehicle identity within one FCD frame is detected, reported and makes R evidence unresolved.
A user-approved T43 envelope requires a nonempty exact quote plus registered payload hashes, scope and no pending launch-card fields.
Independent contract-drift fixtures reject changes to exact EJMI margins, 30-second E1 period and occupancy, speed or q semantics.
An immutable registration payload is hash-linked by the contract, registry and ledger; current proposal and payload hashes are independently recomputed and checked.

reference_reconstruction.method: Source-map hashes and archived XML files were independently read; two E1 lanes were independently combined; FCD frames, within-frame identity uniqueness, endpoint coverage and identity-bracketed first downstream R events were independently reconstructed without production aggregation, EJMI or branch helpers.
reference_reconstruction.revision_comparison: Revision_01 and revision_02 reference scientific and numeric fields are identical; only adapter_sha256 and contract_sha256 changed.
reference_reconstruction.semantic_note: Stage 4 q uses nVehEntered while the Stage 3 q table used nVehContrib. For C23 A this yields 3192.0 versus the Stage 3 value 3189.6 veh/h. The Stage 4 contract explicitly registers nVehEntered; comparisons must not silently mix the two q definitions.
